description: Decodes International Morse code into text. Write dots as "." and dashes as "-"; separate letters with a space and words with " / ", a line break or three spaces. Returns the text in capital letters, lists any groups that are not Morse characters (shown as # in the text), and gives a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com with the code filled in.

morse.description: The Morse code to decode, at most 5000 characters, for example ".... .. / - .... . .-. .".

name: morse_to_text
title: Morse code to text
